guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：低溫電子顯微鏡
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Cryogenic electron microscopes
guides.concept: 以 300 kV 單顆粒低溫電子顯微鏡為對象：從玻璃化與輻射損傷的劑量極限出發，理解離焦相位對比與 CTF 零點、Ewald 球曲率與束致漂移如何限制解析度，再把冷台防污染、直接電子偵測器、像素尺度校正、Rosenthal–Henderson 顆粒數估計與 FSC 驗收整合成設施級的工程交付。
guides.conceptEn: For a 300 kV single-particle cryo-electron microscope: start from vitrification and the dose limits of radiation damage, see how defocus phase contrast with CTF zeros, Ewald-sphere curvature and beam-induced motion bound resolution, then integrate cold-stage anti-contamination, direct electron detectors, pixel-scale calibration, Rosenthal–Henderson particle-number estimates and FSC acceptance into a facility-level engineering delivery.
procedure: 生物分子只有在水環境中才保持結構，但顯微鏡在真空中工作，所以把含水樣品以每秒十萬度的速率急凍成玻璃態冰：水分子來不及結晶，分子被原位固定，低溫同時減緩電子束造成的自由基擴散。即使如此，每個電子穿過樣品都會沉積能量，高解析資訊在幾個電子每平方埃之後就消失，所以每張影像的總劑量被限制在數十 e⁻/Å²，影像極度缺乏訊號，必須靠平均成千上萬個相同顆粒把訊噪比補回來。劑量也要分配成多幀電影，讓後段處理能依每幀累積劑量加權。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「玻璃態冰與劑量預算」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

蛋白質在冰中幾乎不吸收電子，只改變穿透波的相位，正焦時影像幾乎沒有對比；把物鏡調到 1 到 3 µm 的欠焦，相位差經由 sin χ(u) 轉成強度對比，χ(u) = πλΔf·u² − (π/2)·C_s·λ³·u⁴。離焦越大，低頻對比越強、顆粒越容易辨認，但 CTF 的第一個零點越早出現，之後正負交替的傳遞必須在後處理中依每張影像擬合的離焦與像散做相位翻轉或 Wiener 修正，而且離焦必須量得夠準，否則高頻相位會被錯誤翻轉。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「離焦相位對比與 CTF 零點」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

製備在溫濕度受控的急凍儀中進行：3 µL 樣品滴在帶孔碳膜或金膜網格上，濾紙吸去多餘液體只留幾十奈米的薄膜，隨即插入液態乙烷。冰厚是最關鍵的製備參數：太厚則背景的非彈性散射淹沒顆粒對比，太薄則顆粒被擠到孔邊或變性在氣液界面。金網格與金箔支撐膜在冷卻時收縮一致，減少束致漂移；塗石墨烯或親水處理用來控制顆粒分佈與取向。冰厚可用能量過濾器由非彈性散射比例估計。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「急凍儀、網格與冰厚」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

網格在液氮溫度下由自動載入器送入鏡筒，樣品台維持約 −190 °C；鏡筒內任何殘餘水氣都會凝在最冷的表面即樣品上，長出非晶冰層而增加厚度，所以樣品附近設有更冷的冷阱（抗污染器）吸走水氣，並要求超高真空。能量過濾器以 10 到 20 eV 的狹縫去除非彈性電子，提升厚冰與斷層掃描的對比。直接電子偵測器讓每個電子直接在 CMOS 中產生訊號，計數模式把偵測量子效率提升到接近 1 並記錄多幀電影，是 2013 年後解析度突破的硬體基礎；相位板則為小於 100 kDa 的分子提供正焦附近的對比。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「自動載入器、冷阱與直接偵測器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

重建的絕對尺度來自像素尺寸，錯 1% 就讓整個原子模型縮放 1%，因此用已知結構（例如去鐵蛋白的 2.0 Å 重建或金晶格 2.355 Å）校正，並檢查放大率的方向性差異。劑量率在偵測器上以計數校正，再換算到樣品面；劑量過高進入計數非線性區，過低則浪費時間。束傾使彗差把 CTF 變成非對稱，必須做無彗差對準並在資料處理中精修；自動收集用影像位移在多個孔間移動時會引入束傾，所以需要事先校正像移與束傾的補償關係。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「像素尺度、劑量與彗差校正」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

投影近似假設顆粒上下表面的散射在同一平面，實際上繞射發生在半徑 1/λ 的 Ewald 球面上，球面相對於平面的凹陷在高空間頻率與大顆粒時造成上下表面的相位差，必須在重建時依顆粒厚度與離焦做曲率修正。電子束照射的前幾個 e⁻/Å² 會讓冰膜膨脹與翹曲，顆粒在幾埃內移動並旋轉，所以每張電影的幀先做全域與局部對齊，再依劑量加權。再往下是三階以上的像差：三重像散與四階球面像差在 2 Å 以下成為限制，需要以資料本身精修出的像差係數校正。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Ewald 球曲率與束致漂移」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

國家級設施把顯微鏡當成全天候運轉的產線：自動載入器一次裝入十二片網格，自動收集軟體用像移在孔陣列間每幾秒拍一部電影，一天可產出數千部；液氮以自動補給系統連續供應樣品台、冷阱與載入器，中斷即造成樣品損失。資料流是另一個瓶頸：每部電影數十幀的 4k 影像未壓縮超過 1 GB，一天數 TB，必須在收集同時做漂移修正、CTF 擬合與顆粒挑選的即時處理，把回饋在數分鐘內送回操作者以決定是否更換網格。設施還要管理使用者培訓、網格篩選顯微鏡與高解析顯微鏡的分流。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「設施排程、液氮供應與資料管線」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

重建解析度以黃金標準傅立葉殼相關（FSC）定義：把顆粒分成兩半獨立重建，兩圖在各空間頻率的相關降到 0.143 的頻率即為解析度，避免過擬合把雜訊當訊號。設施驗收用去鐵蛋白這類高對稱、高穩定的標準樣品：在規定的收集時間內達到 2 Å 以下證明顯微鏡、偵測器、製備與管線全部正常。交接文件要包含像素尺度與束傾校正、污染速率、偵測器 DQE、標準樣品的 ResLog 曲線與 B 因子、每日檢查清單，以及資料處理的參考流程，讓使用者能用同樣的程序判斷儀器狀態。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「FSC 0.143 與去鐵蛋白基準」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: Biological molecules keep their structure only in water, yet the microscope works in vacuum, so hydrated specimens are frozen at about 10⁵ K/s into vitreous ice: water has no time to crystallise, molecules are fixed in place, and the low temperature slows radical diffusion caused by the beam. Even so, every electron deposits energy, high-resolution information vanishes after a few electrons per square ångström, and the total dose per image is capped at tens of e⁻/Å², leaving images starved of signal that only averaging tens of thousands of identical particles can recover. The dose is also split into a multi-frame movie so later processing can weight each frame by its accumulated exposure. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Vitreous ice and the dose budget”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Proteins in ice barely absorb electrons and only shift the phase of the transmitted wave, so an in-focus image has almost no contrast; underfocusing the objective by 1 to 3 µm converts phase into intensity through sin χ(u), with χ(u) = πλΔf·u² − (π/2)·C_s·λ³·u⁴. Larger defocus strengthens low-frequency contrast and makes particles easier to see, but the first CTF zero arrives earlier, and the alternating transfer beyond it must be phase-flipped or Wiener-corrected in processing using defocus and astigmatism fitted per image; the defocus must be known accurately or high-frequency phases are flipped the wrong way. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Defocus phase contrast and CTF zeros”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Preparation happens in a temperature- and humidity-controlled plunge freezer: 3 µL of sample is applied to a holey carbon or gold-film grid, filter paper blots away excess liquid leaving a film tens of nanometres thick, and the grid is plunged into liquid ethane. Ice thickness is the decisive preparation parameter: too thick and inelastic background swamps particle contrast, too thin and particles are pushed to hole edges or denature at the air-water interface. Gold grids with gold-foil supports contract uniformly on cooling and reduce beam-induced motion; graphene coatings or hydrophilic treatments control particle distribution and orientation. Ice thickness can be estimated with an energy filter from the inelastic-scattering fraction. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Plunge freezer, grids and ice thickness”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Grids enter the column from a liquid-nitrogen autoloader and the stage stays near −190 °C; any residual water vapour in the column condenses on the coldest surface, the specimen, growing amorphous ice that thickens it, so a colder cryo-shield (anti-contaminator) near the specimen captures vapour and ultrahigh vacuum is required. An energy filter with a 10 to 20 eV slit removes inelastic electrons and raises contrast in thick ice and tomography. Direct electron detectors register each electron directly in CMOS; counting mode lifts detective quantum efficiency toward 1 and records multi-frame movies, the hardware basis of the post-2013 resolution leap, while phase plates provide near-focus contrast for molecules below 100 kDa. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Autoloader, cold trap and direct detector”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The absolute scale of a reconstruction comes from pixel size, and a 1% error scales the whole atomic model by 1%, so it is calibrated with a known structure (for example a 2.0 Å apoferritin reconstruction or the 2.355 Å gold lattice) and checked for magnification anisotropy. Dose rate is calibrated on the detector in counts and converted to the specimen plane; too high a rate enters counting non-linearity, too low wastes time. Beam tilt introduces coma that makes the CTF asymmetric, so coma-free alignment is performed and refined in processing; automated collection that moves between holes by image shift introduces beam tilt, so the compensation between image shift and beam tilt must be calibrated beforehand. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Pixel scale, dose and coma-free calibration”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The projection approximation assumes scattering from a particle's top and bottom lies in one plane, but diffraction actually occurs on an Ewald sphere of radius 1/λ, whose sag relative to the plane creates a phase difference between the two surfaces at high spatial frequency and for large particles, requiring curvature correction during reconstruction according to particle thickness and defocus. The first few e⁻/Å² of exposure make the ice film expand and buckle, particles move several ångströms and rotate, so each movie's frames are aligned globally and locally and then dose-weighted. Beyond that, third-order and higher aberrations such as threefold astigmatism and fourth-order spherical aberration become limiting below 2 Å and need aberration coefficients refined from the data themselves. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Ewald-sphere curvature and beam-induced motion”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A national facility runs the microscope as a round-the-clock production line: the autoloader holds twelve grids, automated software records a movie every few seconds across hole arrays by image shift, and thousands of movies are produced per day; liquid nitrogen is supplied continuously by an automatic refill system to stage, cryo-shield and loader, and any interruption costs specimens. Data flow is another bottleneck: a movie of tens of 4k frames exceeds 1 GB uncompressed, days reach several terabytes, and motion correction, CTF fitting and particle picking must run on the fly so that feedback reaches the operator within minutes to decide whether to swap grids. The facility also manages user training and the split between screening and high-resolution microscopes. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Facility scheduling, nitrogen supply and data pipeline”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Reconstruction resolution is defined by the gold-standard Fourier shell correlation (FSC): particles are split into two halves reconstructed independently, and the frequency where their correlation falls to 0.143 is the resolution, which prevents overfitting from passing noise off as signal. Facility acceptance uses a highly symmetric, stable standard such as apoferritin: reaching better than 2 Å within a specified collection time proves microscope, detector, preparation and pipeline all work. The handoff package must hold pixel-scale and beam-tilt calibrations, contamination rate, detector DQE, the standard sample's ResLog curve and B-factor, a daily checklist and a reference processing workflow so users can judge instrument state by the same procedure. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “FSC 0.143 and the apoferritin benchmark”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 轉移樣品時冷卻鉗短暫離開液氮，網格升溫超過 −137 °C，玻璃態冰轉成立方冰，顆粒被擠壓變形且背景出現繞射環，整批網格資料不可用而且往往在收完數千張影像後才發現。
像移式自動收集沒有校正束傾補償，離中心 10 µm 的孔帶有 1 mrad 的束傾，這些影像的高頻相位被彗差破壞，重建解析度卡在 3.5 Å，直到依孔位置分組精修束傾才恢復到 2.8 Å。
pitfallsEn: Tweezers leaving liquid nitrogen briefly during transfer let the grid warm above −137 °C, vitreous ice turns cubic, particles are crushed and diffraction rings appear in the background; the whole grid's data are unusable, often discovered only after thousands of images are collected.

Image-shift collection without beam-tilt compensation leaves holes 10 µm off-centre with 1 mrad of tilt; coma corrupts their high-frequency phases, the reconstruction stalls at 3.5 Å, and only grouping by hole position and refining beam tilt restores 2.8 Å.

related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Vitrification, radiation damage and low-dose imaging" and "Data-collection calibration: pixel scale, dose rate and beam tilt" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Transmission electron microscopes must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦玻璃態冰、低劑量相位對比、CTF 與 Ewald 球修正、直接偵測器與設施級產出；穿透電子顯微鏡則以300 kV 電子波長、相位對比傳遞函數、Cs 校正與資訊極限的穩定度工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on vitreous ice, low-dose phase contrast, CTF and Ewald-sphere correction, direct detectors and facility-scale throughput; Transmission electron microscopes centres on 300 kV electron wavelength, phase-contrast transfer function, Cs correction and the stability engineering behind the information limit, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 低溫電子顯微鏡
history.text: 1980 年代 Dubochet 在 EMBL 證明水可被急凍成玻璃態冰並在電子顯微鏡中觀察，解決了含水樣品的真空問題；Frank 發展單顆粒平均與三維重建方法，Henderson 以細菌視紫質示範接近原子解析度的電子晶體學，三人於 2017 年獲諾貝爾化學獎。2013 年直接電子偵測器與電影式漂移修正帶來「解析度革命」，單顆粒重建普遍進入 3 Å 以下；國家級設施如英國 Diamond 光源的 eBIC 以 300 kV 自動化顯微鏡提供全天候的使用者服務，2020 年去鐵蛋白達到 1.2 Å。本課只重建公開原理與工程方法。
history.textEn: In the 1980s Dubochet at EMBL showed that water can be flash-frozen into vitreous ice and observed in the electron microscope, solving the vacuum problem for hydrated specimens; Frank developed single-particle averaging and three-dimensional reconstruction, Henderson demonstrated near-atomic electron crystallography with bacteriorhodopsin, and the three shared the 2017 Nobel Prize in Chemistry. In 2013 direct electron detectors and movie-based motion correction brought the resolution revolution, with single-particle reconstructions routinely below 3 Å; national facilities such as eBIC at the UK's Diamond Light Source provide round-the-clock user service on automated 300 kV microscopes, and apoferritin reached 1.2 Å in 2020. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering methods only.

history.text: 本課把「玻璃化、輻射損傷與低劑量成像」到「解析度驗證、標準樣品基準與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
